package demo;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Function;

public sealed interface Shape permits Circle, Square {}
record Circle(double r) implements Shape {}
record Square(double s) implements Shape {}

public class Modern<T extends Comparable<? super T>> {
    private static final String TEXT = """
        hello
        world""";
    private final List<T> items = new ArrayList<>();
    @SafeVarargs
    public final Modern<T> add(T... xs) { items.addAll(List.of(xs)); return this; }
    public static double area(Shape s) {
        return switch (s) {
            case Circle c -> Math.PI * c.r() * c.r();
            case Square q -> q.s() * q.s();
        };
    }
    public <R> List<R> map(Function<? super T, ? extends R> f) {
        var out = new ArrayList<R>();
        for (var x : items) out.add(f.apply(x));
        return out;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try (var sc = new Scanner(System.in)) {
            if (args.length > 0 && args[0] instanceof String s && !s.isEmpty()) System.out.println(s);
        }
        int[] a = {1, 2, 3};
        Object o = (Object) a;
        char c = '\u0041';
        long l = 1_000_000L;
        label: for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { if (i == 1) continue label; }
    }
}
